title: Ten-floor Crown Hotel on the street map
summary: Visit 200 varied guest rooms in a new hotel connected to the street district.
notes: Add ten storeys with twenty numbered guest rooms each, socket-connected corridors, reception and themed floor lounges using the existing vintage hotel models.
Use the west-side reception teleporter and ride the garage’s physical elevator across ten hotel floors, with sliding-door interlocks, original cab/audio and authenticated controls.
Arrange beds, bedside tables, desks, chairs and lounge furniture in authored groups; stream floors around the rider, batch repeated furniture and cull distant props.
Show a simplified copy of the same streets and buildings through framed windows using 32px textures and no extra rendering cameras.
